scientific_limitations.integrity: Symbolic infinite proof; finite exact tests are supplementary. No statement about infinitude of non-Wieferich primes. Possible prior equivalent irreducibility criteria are a residual originality risk.
scientific_limitations.scope: Odd primes non-Wieferich to base two; r >= 2 and s >= 1 prime to p. Composite indices and Wieferich primes are not classified.

title: Prime-index Apéry polynomials are irreducible at non-Wieferich primes
